justification: Assessment reported INVALID and its counterexample is the 2-cycle on two vertices with edges in both directions, whose transitive reduction is unique despite the graph being cyclic - the identical defect and essentially identical witness as the ground truth (2-cycle a<->b refuting 'unique transitive reduction => acyclic'). The assessment also notes an additional minimality/irredundancy gap at step 0030, but the matching converse-direction counterexample is central to its verdict.
